issue.title: Add the [buffer::] occupied-span sentence to glossary:event-task
issue.description:
Proposed by every bob-cli-fk phase (bob-cli-fk.1 #1, .2 #1, .4 #1, .5 #1, .6 #1) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. The epic's auto decision `memory_event_task_glossary = no` (default false; no human reviewed the plan) forbade editing glossary:event-task inside the epic, so the strand still says nothing about buffers.

Epic bob-cli-fk (plan:202611/gcal_event_buffers.md) added the Google-owned `[buffer:: -30m +15m]` field to Event Tasks. decisions:event-buffers-widen-the-span records the two-spans rule; docs/gcal.md "Buffers", docs/capture.md, and docs/reference/vault-format.md document it.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add one sentence: an Event Task may carry [buffer:: -30m +15m] (from -N/+M directive lines in the Google description, or hand-written), which widens the span the event occupies (MEET event runs, run-into-event warnings, agenda gaps, gcal sync phases and MEET spans), while the bold meeting span and timed close keep the bare meeting time. Link [[decisions:event-buffers-widen-the-span]]. Republish with sase memory init.

issue.creation_reason: Five bob-cli-fk phases proposed this sentence but the epic's auto decision declined the glossary edit, so Bryan should decide it explicitly.
